title: Your first little match
lesson: Bring three of the same food together on one tray.

tutorial_guide.title: Three is the magic number
tutorial_guide.body: Tap the highlighted tomato, then the empty space beside the other two. You can drag it there, too.

tutorial_guide.title: Lovely! Now try the corn
tutorial_guide.body: Three tomatoes matched and cleared. Bring the last corn beside its two friends for another match.

tutorial_complete: Two lovely matches! Only three identical foods clear. Mixed food can share a tray while you make room.
